summary: Wired /gateway_restart to write a best-effort restart sentinel before triggering restart, with Telegram delivery context and sessionKey (telegram:<chatId>), and removed immediate accepted-path sendMessage so only rejected cases reply immediately. Added accountId to registerGatewayRestartCommand params and passed it from bot-native-commands. Updated gateway-restart tests to mock writeRestartSentinel, pass accountId in harness, assert no immediate accepted confirmation, and verify sentinel payload shape. Verification: pnpm vitest run src/telegram/gateway-restart.test.ts (7 passed), pnpm build (passed).
